title: Geceye Uyananlar
author: Cahide Birgül
description: Haluk, enslaved by guilt and the lure of power, lives under the shadow of his criminal ties. His sister Nilüfer struggles with her own identity, while their disabled brother Memo embodies the family’s deepest secrets and shame. Weaving themes of violence, sexuality, and political history, Birgül tells the powerful story of three siblings trapped together yet divided, slowly pulled into the abyss of their own darkness.
